title: Disruptoor v1 State
description: Body of PUT /v1/state and the canonical schema for files passed to --config. The same shape is returned by GET /v1/state, reflecting applied (not requested) state.

selector.description: Either the literal string "all" (matches every container in the enclave) or a label-match object: keys are label suffixes (the configured label-prefix is prepended for keys without a dot), values are string/number/array-of-either. Multiple values OR within a key; multiple keys AND across keys.

symmetric.description: Defaults to true. v0 only supports symmetric partitions.

isolation.description: Cuts the containers matched by target off from the rest of the enclave. The counterparty set is computed at apply time as the complement of target; semantically a symmetric two-group partition of target vs the rest of the enclave. A multi-container target is isolated as a group (traffic among its members is unaffected); declare one isolation per container to black out several containers individually.

target.description: Must be a label-match object; the literal "all" is rejected because isolating everything leaves nothing to isolate from.
v0: target is required (between is reserved for future use).

between.description: Reserved. v0 rejects any non-empty between.

scope.description: v0 tc shaping affects all egress traffic. Must be set to ["include_control"] to acknowledge.

direction.description: v0: only egress is supported. Ingress/both require ifb redirects (not implemented).
